newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST -Scottish Hydro yr profits to rise.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST -Scottish Hydro yr profits to rise.

text.p: Electricity generator Scottish Hydro-Electric Plc is expected to turn in an improvement in year results and a strong dividend rise when it reports on June 12, analysts said, although hot weather could have hurt output.
"There could be some damage from low hydro-electric output, that may have pushed up costs," said one analyst who asked not to be named.
Britain is currently suffering its worst drought for 200 years which has hit groundwater levels, although many reservoirs are at average capacity for the time of year.

Scottish Hydro's pretax profits are expected to be between 202.6 and 210 million stg, up from 195.1 million stg previously, with a dividend payout of 17.5-17.8 pence per share compared with 15.76 pence a year ago.
Scottish Hydro hiked its half year dividend 11 percent and promised then that it aimed to "keep on delivering dividend improvement."
Analysts said the company's gearing could come in around 60 percent after it agreed to buy out its joint venture partner United Utilities from Keadby Power for 123 million stg in February.
They added that news regarding growth in the business including sales to English customers would interest the market with the company's focus likely to be on investment in generating assets.
